walking_route_clear_width.label: clear width of a walking route or corridor

door_clear_width.label: clear width of a door opening

handrail_height.label: height of the top of a handrail above the walking surface

ballast_water_exchange_efficiency.label: volumetric efficiency of ballast water exchange

rules.title: Clear width of walking surfaces
rules.exceptions: May be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) minimum for a length of 24 inches (610 mm) maximum, and 403.5.2 and 403.5.3 also apply.

source.quote: the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of walking surfaces on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: May be reduced to 32 inches (815 mm) minimum for a length of 24 inches (610 mm) maximum, and V403.5.2 and V403.5.3 also apply.

source.quote: the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of door openings
rules.exceptions: Openings more than 24 inches (610 mm) deep need 36 inches (915 mm) minimum. Measure swinging doors between the door face and the stop with the door open 90 degrees.

source.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Clear width of door openings on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: Openings more than 24 inches (610 mm) deep need 36 inches (915 mm) minimum. Measure swinging doors between the door face and the stop with the door open 90 degrees.

source.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

rules.title: Running slope of ramps
rules.exceptions: Existing sites, buildings and facilities may use the steeper slopes in Table 405.2 where space is limited.

source.quote: Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

rules.title: Running slope of ramps on passenger vessels
rules.exceptions: Alterations may use Table V405.2 where space is limited. A slope steeper than 1:8 is prohibited.

source.quote: Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

rules.title: Handrail height
rules.required_text: 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Handrails must also be at a consistent height above walking surfaces, stair nosings and ramp surfaces.

source.quote: Top of gripping surfaces of handrails shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum

rules.title: Handrail height on passenger vessels
rules.required_text: 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum
rules.exceptions: Applies above walking surfaces, stair nosings, gangway surfaces and ramp surfaces. Check the exceptions in V503.4.

source.quote: Top of gripping surfaces of handrails shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum

rules.title: Ballast water exchange efficiency
rules.exceptions: Pumping through three times the volume of each ballast tank is considered to meet the standard.

source.quote: shall do so with an efficiency of at least 95 percent volumetric exchange of ballast water.
